description:
Lightning in a throttle. The new Mongoose React E4 Electric Scooter is portable, powerful and ready to cruise any sidewalk. The torque heavy E4 tops out at 15 miles per hour, and can travel up to 6 miles on a single charge. So whether you’re a scooter afficionado or a total n00b, a Mongoose e-scooter is sure to be your youngin's favorite new set of wheels. Your Ride Electrified.
Rider Profile: Designed for tween or adult riders ages 13 and up, with a maximum weight limit of 176 pounds.
Motor and Throttle: Its high-power hub drive motor tops out at 15 MPH. To get up to speed, kick start the scooter and use the hand lever throttle to accelerate.
Battery and Charging: Powered by a long-lasting lithium battery and can travel up to 6 miles on a single charge. Charge time of 3 hours on a standard 110v home outlet. Charger included.
Wheels and Brakes: Durable 152 mm rubber wheels offer a smooth ride while the rear foot brake or hand e-brake disengage the motor to make stopping safe and simple.
Frame and Coasting: The E4's lightweight aluminum frame folds up making it to transport and the kickstand makes it easy to store. When the battery runs out, it converts into a kick scooter for resistance-free riding.
